kinds.d: Pipe, fitting and water-sealed trap for the waste outlet of a basin, sink or bath.
Gutter and downpipe sections and fittings that carry rainwater from a roof.
Large-bore pipe and fittings that carry waste from toilets and drains to the sewer, above or below ground.
